description: This file defines an enumeration 'TailscaleNetwork' with methods to identify and detect Tailscale Tailnet IPv4 addresses by analyzing network interface addresses.

methods.name: isTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Checks if a given IPv4 address string belongs to the Tailnet IPv4 range by validating its format and octet values.

methods.name: detectTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Iterates through network interface IPv4 addresses and returns the first that matches the Tailnet IPv4 criteria.
